blurb: Bay Point Water Sports offers a variety of aquatic adventures including dolphin tours, jet ski rentals, and pontoon boat rentals. Guests can get up-close with local bottlenose dolphins or explore Shell Island and St. Andrews Bay. Pontoon boats are stable and easy to operate, suitable for family and friends to captain their own adventure.
extraNote: Located at the East end of Hathaway Bridge, look for the Papa Joe's signs.
